title: Sanctioning Iranian Regime Insiders Who Profit from Stolen Oil Wealth
snippet: Thomas "Tommy" Pigott, SpokesmanOffice of the Spokesman Press Statement November 20, 2026 Today, the United States took action against four corrupt Iranian regime insiders who illicitly sell oil to help fund the regime’s military and its support for terrorism. Those designated include a former Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) intelligence officer and the son of the head of Mahan Air, an airline the regime uses to move weapons and fighters for the IRGC-Qods Force.
